department: Biomedical Engineering (Virginia Tech-Wake Forest School of Biomedical Engineering and Sciences)

deadline.value: The Biomedical Engineering PhD deadline is December 15 for Fall entry.

gre_general.value: The Biomedical Engineering MS and PhD required items list no GRE.
gre_general.quote: Personal information, Transcripts, 2 Recommendation letters, Personal statement (Written), Attestation statement, Application fee

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies on the fetched pages.

app_fee.value: Most School of Medicine programs charge $70 to apply, not the Graduate School's $80.
app_fee.quote: Most programs have a $70 fee, or a waiver code

fee_waiver.value: School of Medicine waivers depend on financial need or past program participation; international applicants face the same narrow criteria.
fee_waiver.quote: International students are held to the same criteria as domestic students with regard to fee waiver requests

toefl_min.value: The School of Medicine requires a TOEFL total of 90, higher than the Graduate School's new 4.5 scale.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum total score on the TOEFL is 90

funding.value: Accepted PhD students get a full-tuition scholarship and a health insurance supplement, and PhD students get a living-cost stipend.
funding.quote: Students accepted to one of our PhD programs will receive a full-tuition scholarship and health insurance supplement

entry_route.value: Undergraduate seniors and graduates of accredited institutions may apply directly.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate seniors and graduates of accredited U.S. colleges and universities or recognized foreign institutions may apply for admission

supervisor.value: The school pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor's agreement is needed before admission.

notes: The PhD and MS in Biomedical Engineering are offered exclusively through the Virginia Tech-Wake Forest school and awarded jointly by both universities. Applications go through the Wake Forest School of Medicine portal.
